Here’s the most recent example:

Last week, I went into the health centre to book an appointment, as instructed by a text message sent from the practice. Was told that I just need to call at 8am. Advised that it was an ongoing issue, so ‘receptionist’ checked again, and found that I had an appointment booked for June 27th. Had received NO notification about the appointment.

By end of week I received a text saying that I had a face to face appointment booked for Monday 23rd at 2pm.

Today at 11:30x received phone call from doctor, entirely unexpected and unscheduled, therefore the call was missed. Rang surgery, and after waiting 15 minutes for an answer in a queue of just two people, was told again by the alleged receptionist that I didn’t have a face to face appointment booked, just call. Could not tell me the scheduled time.

NO explanation for the messaging around, and of course, NO apology or contrition. And also, NO way of formally complaining about the practice unless you hand write a letter. Yep. In 2025 there are no email or phone resources to take complaints.

A disgrace of a practice time and time again. From failing to notify me of test results without me having to chase, to incorrect diagnoses. Today was the straw that broke the camels back.

Avoid this practice like your life depends on it.",null,[0,87]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25wYWJGSktiVzFwTld4QlNVRlJVbVZZWjBOU1lrRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xc38e2cf95fb4e1aa!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOnpabFJKbW1pNWxBSUFRUmVYZ0NSYkE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25wYWJGSktiVzFwTld4QlNVRlJVbVZZWjBOU1lrRRAB&t=1&_5LI7DKgswY0xJU01sYmxqVw&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiWh9Hll7WTAxWgMGMBHeNeA7MQoykIECgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiWh9Hll7WTAxWgMGMBHeNeA7MQ0pMFCA4oBA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMmhxWmpsRWJsOWZSV2hFVDFwNGNGcGpURVJqTUc1Tk1rcFBSVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEprVlVOaFIwNWZNRTlqV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNvNm9lc2xnRRAB",["0x0:0xc38e2cf95fb4e1aa",null,1744801785240994,1744801953903835,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107875525294400445116/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["H S","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLcMRuu3-m9dbIioBHXXHiwQ6UK3dZY21g2scLwJ8Yp3qCrJQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107875525294400445116?hl=en"],"107875525294400445116",null,17,0,null,[1,4,1],0,["Local Guide · 17 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiWh9Hll7WTAxWgMGMBHeNeA7MQ7LoGCBIoAA"]]]],null,"11 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Tried to get an appointment for elderly relative in their 90's.
